The move aims to enhance workflow automation, customer engagement, and overall business operations by offering diverse model choices through Pega Connect GenAI while ensuring unified governance and control.

title: Opinion: Oracle’s cloud AI deals excite investors, but do they have long-term potential?
summary: Oracle's stock surged after its fiscal fourth-quarter earnings report, driven by investor excitement over cloud AI deals with Microsoft and Google Cloud, overshadowing an earnings miss. Larry Ellison, Oracle's CTO, highlighted a future vision of interconnected cloud services sharing data center capacity. The article questions the long-term potential of these deals despite the initial investor enthusiasm.

title: Tech Firms Ask NextEra for Enough Electricity to Power Entire Cities
summary: Technology companies are seeking immense amounts of electricity from NextEra Energy Inc. to power new data centers, with some requests for up to 5 gigawatts, enough to power entire cities. This surge in demand, driven by AI and data centers, is leading NextEra to consider diverse power sources, including the potential reopening of nuclear plants and a significant increase in renewable energy projects. The CEO expects a nearly 40% rise in US power demand over the next two decades, with renewables positioned to meet most of this growth due to cost and grid connection challenges for new fossil-fuel plants.

title: This tech skill is one of Upwork's most in-demand for 2024—and it can pay $167 per hour
summary: Data analytics is identified by Upwork as a highly in-demand skill for 2024, with freelancers potentially earning up to $167 per hour. The role involves analyzing business data to provide insights for improvement, and its value is increasing due to the integration of AI for deeper and faster analysis. Professionals who can leverage new technologies, especially AI, in data analytics are expected to be particularly successful.

title: Top Stock Movers Now: Oracle, D.R. Horton, Casey’s General Stores, and More
summary: U.S. equities, including the S&P 500, Dow, and Nasdaq, saw gains at midday on Wednesday, June 12, 2024, following a softer-than-expected inflation report which increased optimism for Federal Reserve interest rate cuts. Oracle shares surged to an all-time high due to cloud infrastructure deals with major tech companies, while home builders like D.R. Horton also advanced on hopes of lower borrowing costs. Casey’s General Stores reached a record high driven by strong earnings and dividend boost, but Exelon and Elevance Health shares declined on regulatory and earnings news respectively.

title: Spin-off da UFMG é adquirida pelo Grupo Bradesco
summary: The UFMG spin-off Kunumi, co-founded by professor Nívio Ziviani and CEO Alberto Colares, has been acquired by Bradesco Holding de Investimentos S.A. Kunumi, established in 2016, specializes in artificial intelligence, developing a platform that mimics brain function to analyze large datasets and solve complex problems. This acquisition highlights an innovative legal model where UFMG, as a co-founder, benefits from the company's success through an usufruct of shares agreement.

title: Amazon adds $230 million in cloud credits to AI startups
summary: Amazon announced it is investing an additional $230 million in Amazon Web Services (AWS) credits to support early-stage artificial intelligence startups. This initiative aims to provide these generative AI companies with free access to computing power, various AI models, and infrastructure, provided they build their solutions on AWS. The move is part of a broader strategy by cloud providers to attract and retain AI clients, with part of the credits also funding 80 startups in the AWS Generative AI Accelerator program.

title: Case Study: AI Integration at InterContinental Hotels Group (IHG)
summary: InterContinental Hotels Group (IHG) has partnered with Google Cloud to integrate generative AI into its IHG One Rewards mobile app, aiming to launch a new travel planning feature in late 2024. This initiative utilizes Google’s Vertex AI and Gemini models to offer personalized travel recommendations, enhancing customer experience and loyalty. While promising increased engagement and efficiency, the project faces challenges related to data security, privacy, and potential job displacement from automation.

title: AI in Finance
summary: A new Citi GPS report predicts Artificial Intelligence (AI) will profoundly transform finance, potentially boosting global banking industry profits by 9% to $2 trillion by 2028. While AI promises significant productivity gains and profit increases for banks, it also introduces challenges related to data security, regulation, ethics, and potential market share loss for incumbents. The article emphasizes that while AI's potential is widely recognized, finance firms are still navigating the transition from hype to mass adoption.

title: Construction giant CRH’s reuse strategy is winning customers such as Google
summary: CRH, an international construction material supplier, is successfully implementing a reuse strategy that attracts major customers like Google. The company's focus on sustainable products, including those made from recycled materials and lower-carbon alternatives, accounted for 40% of its 2023 revenue, with a goal to reach 50% by 2025. CRH is also actively involved in over 400 pilot projects for waste reuse and climate-resilient infrastructure, alongside significant water management initiatives, driving both environmental benefits and financial opportunities.

title: How Eli Lilly is managing soaring demand for GLP-1s, according to outgoing CFO Anat Ashkenazi
summary: Eli Lilly's outgoing CFO Anat Ashkenazi discusses the company's efforts to manage the surging demand for its GLP-1 drugs, Zepbound and Mounjaro. The company is heavily investing in manufacturing expansion and working to improve patient access by addressing insurance coverage limitations for weight loss treatments. Additionally, Eli Lilly aims to reframe the public perception of obesity as a chronic disease rather than a lifestyle choice.

title: FOX Announces TIME as its First Publishing Partner on Verify Protocol
summary: Fox Corporation announced TIME as its first external publishing partner for its Verify protocol, an open-source solution for content verification and licensing. The Verify protocol uses blockchain technology to cryptographically sign content, establishing its origin and history to combat misinformation and create commercial opportunities. FOX also plans to transition Verify beta from the Polygon Proof-of-Stake network to a dedicated zero-knowledge blockchain on Ethereum using Polygon CDK.

title: 10 Things You Didn’t Know About the Holiday Inn Brand – From Fun Facts to Pioneering Moments, Illuminating the Brand’s Ongoing Leadership in Mainstream Hospitality
summary: This article highlights 10 pioneering aspects and fun facts about the Holiday Inn brand, which is recognized as the most trusted travel and hospitality brand in the U.S. It recounts how founder Kemmons Wilson innovated key services like free stays for kids, onsite restaurants, and in-room technology. The brand's history also includes establishing the first hotel loyalty program and reservation system, promoting diversity, and expanding globally.

title: Nvidia eclipses Microsoft as world's most valuable company
summary: Nvidia has surpassed Microsoft to become the world's most valuable company, with its market capitalization reaching $3.341 trillion. This surge is driven by high demand for its processors essential for artificial intelligence technology. Nvidia's stock has nearly tripled this year, reflecting the market's strong optimism about its role in the booming AI sector.

title: Nvidia becomes world’s most valuable company amid AI boom
summary: Nvidia has become the world's most valuable company, surpassing Microsoft and Apple, with its market capitalization reaching $3.34 trillion. This surge is driven by high demand for its chips, which are central to the booming artificial intelligence industry. The company's exponential growth has also significantly increased CEO Jensen Huang's net worth and boosted the broader stock market.

title: Nvidia beats Microsoft to become world's most valuable company
summary: Nvidia has surpassed Microsoft to become the world's most valuable company with a market capitalization of $3.34tn, driven by its dominance in AI chips. Its stock has nearly doubled this year, reflecting explosive growth fueled by demand for its technology, though some analysts are cautious about future gains amid increasing competition.

title: Amazon (AMZN) Strengthens Blink Portfolio With Blink Moments
summary: Amazon recently launched Blink Moments for its Blink Subscription Plus Plan members, enhancing its smart home security offerings by automatically condensing clips from multiple Blink cameras into a single, streamlined video. This initiative, alongside previous launches like the Blink Mini 2 and Blink Outdoor 4 cameras, positions Amazon to capitalize on the growing smart home security market, which is projected to reach $61.97 billion by 2029. The company's strengthened Blink portfolio gives it a competitive edge against rivals like Honeywell, Adobe, and Alphabet in this expanding sector.

title: Kraft, Walmart, & WestRock Dish on Demand Planning, Supply Chain Platform Implementation
summary: Brand owners, retailers, and packaging suppliers are integrating complex, disparate supply chain tech stacks into single "digital brain" platforms like o9. Early adopters, including Kraft Heinz and WestRock, advise a modular approach to implementation, emphasizing small wins and empathizing with end-users. Key takeaways include treating data as an asset, understanding current processes before applying AI, prioritizing collaboration, and embracing "fail fast" strategies in digital transformation.

title: Microsoft Strikes 2 Record-Breaking Carbon Credit Deals
summary: Microsoft has made two significant moves in the carbon credit market, signing a record-breaking deal with BTG Pactual Timberland Investment Group for 8 million carbon removal credits, and an additionally largest-ever individual purchase of 40,000 agricultural soil carbon credits from Indigo Ag. These agreements are part of Microsoft's ambitious commitment to become carbon-negative by 2030 and eliminate all historical emissions by 2050, demonstrating its strategy to invest in large-scale, high-quality carbon removal projects, especially in nature-based solutions. The company's efforts also include a collaboration with other tech giants and a focus on reducing its significant Scope 3 emissions.

title: Apple Intelligence won't launch in EU in 2024 due to antitrust regulation, company says
summary: Apple announced that its Apple Intelligence AI product and three other new features will not be launched in the European Union in 2024. This delay is attributed to "regulatory uncertainties" stemming from the EU's Digital Markets Act (DMA), which Apple believes could compromise user privacy and data security due to interoperability requirements. Apple stated it would work with the EU to find a solution that allows the features to be rolled out without compromising safety.

title: Apple is first tech company accused of violating EU's new competition law
summary: The European Union has accused Apple of violating its new Digital Markets Act, making Apple the first tech company to face charges under the law. The investigation focuses on Apple's app store rules, which allegedly hinder developers from directing consumers to alternative purchasing methods. Apple has a chance to respond before a final decision in March 2025, potentially facing fines up to 20% of its global revenue for repeated infringements.

title: How law firm Robbins Geller won $434 mln post-dismissal settlement with Under Armour
summary: Robbins Geller Rudman & Dowd secured a $434 million settlement with Under Armour in a securities class action lawsuit, a record amount for a previously dismissed shareholder class action. The case, which dragged on for years and involved an unusual procedural maneuver to revive it after an initial dismissal, is seen by the firm as proof of its value. This outcome aligns with academic research suggesting that top-tier law firms achieve better results in cases against companies with mid-range market capitalizations, where substantial investment is needed.

title: What Does Chipotle’s Stock Split Mean for Investors?
summary: Chipotle Mexican Grill (CMG) executed a 50-for-1 stock split on June 25, one of the largest in NYSE history, resulting in shareholders receiving 49 additional shares for each one owned. The split aims to increase liquidity and make shares more accessible to individual investors, although it does not change the company's underlying value. Morningstar's fair value estimate for Chipotle stock has been adjusted to $40 per share following the split.

title: Wipro chairman Rishad Premji to shareholders: Uniting … is at the core of Wipro
summary: Wipro Chairman Rishad Premji has addressed shareholders, emphasizing that uniting employees, clients, shareholders, partners, and communities is central to the company's ethos. He highlighted Wipro's significant investment in AI, training over 225,000 employees in GenAI fundamentals and 30,000 in advanced skills, viewing AI as a crucial element for long-term value creation and industry transformation. Premji also expressed confidence in new CEO Srini Pallia's leadership, despite a challenging FY24 which saw a revenue decrease but an increase in net income and strong operating cash flow.

title: How Global Regulators Are Catching Up With Temu
summary: Global regulators, lawmakers, and consumers are increasingly scrutinizing Temu's e-commerce platform due to concerns about its data collection practices. Arkansas has filed a lawsuit alleging the app functions as malware and spyware, while previous class-action suits and congressional inquiries raised similar issues. Internationally, Temu faces investigations in Indonesia for violating direct-to-consumer regulations, in South Korea for inappropriate sales, and has been designated a Very Large Online Platform under the EU's Digital Services Act due to manipulative practices and product risks.

title: Webtoon Entertainment soars on Nasdaq debut, eyes global franchise success
summary: Webtoon Entertainment successfully debuted on the Nasdaq, with CEO Kim Jun-koo envisioning the company as a source of major global franchises. The company's IPO attracted significant investment and closed 9.5 percent higher than its initial offering price, valuing it at over $2.9 billion. Webtoon plans to use the IPO proceeds to expand its platform and advertising, particularly in the North American market, leveraging its profitable operating cash flow and diverse content.

title: Fumble! Your Favorite NFL Team Is On The Hook For $450 Million In Sunday Ticket Lawsuit, 1.76x More Than Player Pay In 2024
summary: A federal jury has ruled that the NFL must pay between $4.7 billion and $14.4 billion in damages due to a class-action lawsuit over anticompetitive practices related to the Sunday Ticket television package. If the maximum amount is upheld, each of the 32 NFL teams would be liable for approximately $450 million, an amount significantly higher than their 2024 player salaries. The NFL plans to appeal the verdict.

title: Active investing is suited to the uncertain markets ahead
summary: The article argues that changing market conditions, characterized by higher rates, greater dispersion, and heightened volatility, will favor active investing over passive strategies. While passive investing saw significant growth in recent decades, primarily due to low interest rates and index concentration, narrowing fee gaps and the rise of active ETFs suggest a shift in the investment landscape. Active managers with strong research capabilities are expected to thrive by identifying opportunities in a more discerning market.

title: 5 Stocks to Buy for 3Q 2024
summary: Morningstar Chief US Markets Strategist Dave Sekera discusses the Q3 2024 stock and bond market outlook and recommends five stocks for the quarter: ExxonMobil, Fortinet, International Flavors and Fragrances, Baxter International, and Ventas Inc. He also reviews recent earnings reports, key economic data, and Morningstar's fair value estimates for several companies, including Taiwan Semiconductor and Chipotle. The discussion highlights concerns about consumer spending, market concentration in large-cap tech stocks, and opportunities in undervalued sectors like small-cap and value stocks.

title: 13 Charts On the Market’s Q2 Turnaround
summary: The article provides a detailed analysis of the market's performance in Q2 2024, highlighting a turnaround despite initial inflation worries. It emphasizes that stocks rebounded due to improving inflation data and strong earnings, with megacap tech and AI stocks, particularly Nvidia, driving the gains. The Federal Reserve's anticipated interest rate cuts in September also contributed to positive sentiment in both stock and bond markets.

title: Redfin, Zillow named in video privacy lawsuits
summary: Redfin and Zillow are facing two separate class-action lawsuits filed in California, alleging violations of video privacy laws. The lawsuits claim the real estate companies shared consumers' personally identifiable data, including names and email addresses, with third-party firms like Meta and Alphabet after users viewed agent-created video home tours. The plaintiff is seeking class-action status, punitive damages, and orders to prevent further unauthorized disclosure of consumer data.

title: The AI Revolution's Next Phase Isn't Possible Without "Einstein's Blueprint"
summary: The surge in AI and EV adoption is significantly increasing global energy demands, with data centers alone consuming vast amounts of electricity. This article highlights nuclear power as a crucial, clean, and reliable energy source making a comeback to meet this rising demand. The author suggests investing in the VanEck Uranium and Nuclear ETF (NLR) as a diversified way to capitalize on nuclear energy's resurgence and the development of new technologies like Small Modular Reactors.

title: Hybrid and Multi-Cloud technologies in 2024: Developments, challenges, and Innovations
summary: The article explores the developments, challenges, and innovations in hybrid and multi-cloud technologies in 2024. It highlights enhanced interoperability, advanced security measures, and the integration of AI and Machine Learning as key advancements. The piece also discusses management complexity, security concerns, and vendor lock-in as significant challenges, while presenting edge computing, Kubernetes, and serverless computing as innovations enabling wider adoption.

title: 3 Reasons to Buy BULZ, and 4 Reasons Not To
summary: This article examines the MicroSectors Solactive FANG Innovation 3x Leveraged ETN (BULZ), outlining three reasons to consider investing in it and four reasons to be cautious. The ETN offers a concentrated, equal-weighted, and leveraged investment in top tech stocks, but comes with high volatility, potential for the underlying premise to fail, high expense ratios, and a warning from the issuer against long-term holding.

title: E.l.f. Cosmetics Is Selling Real-World Products on Roblox
summary: E.l.f. Cosmetics is expanding its presence on Roblox by becoming the first beauty brand to sell real-world products through the platform. U.S. users aged 13 and up can purchase items like hoodies and lip balm via a Walmart-powered virtual kiosk within the "E.l.f. UP!" experience, receiving a "virtual twin" digital item with each purchase. This move highlights E.l.f.'s innovative marketing strategy and Roblox's growing appeal as a commerce platform for brands.

title: Declare your AIndependence: block AI bots, scrapers and crawlers with a single click
summary: Cloudflare has launched a new "easy button" feature allowing all customers, including those on the free tier, to block AI bots, scrapers, and crawlers from their websites. This initiative responds to concerns from content creators about AI companies scraping content for model training without transparency or permission. The article details the prevalence of various AI bots like Bytespider, GPTBot, and ClaudeBot across Cloudflare's network and explains how Cloudflare's machine learning models effectively identify and block even evasive AI bots attempting to spoof user agents.

title: Nike CFO Matthew Friend sells $889k in company stock
summary: Matthew Friend, Nike's CFO, sold 9,350 shares of the company's Class B Common Stock for a total of $889,185 on June 5, 2024. This transaction was conducted under a prearranged 10b5-1 trading plan. Despite the sale, Friend still retains a significant number of shares, and insider transactions are often monitored by investors for insights into company dynamics.

title: Driving surge in demand for power, data centers eye Kentucky
summary: Kentucky is emerging as a potential location for new data centers driven by the artificial intelligence boom, with state lawmakers offering tax incentives and utilities preparing for increased power demand. However, this development raises concerns among environmental advocates regarding the financial burden on consumers for new infrastructure and the potential reliance on fossil fuels, as Kentucky currently has minimal renewable energy sources. The article highlights the significant power needs of data centers and the considerations for balancing economic growth with environmental impact.

title: “Future of Professionals Report” shows rising power of GenAI to impact work
summary: A new report by Thomson Reuters, the 2nd annual Future of Professionals Report, highlights that AI and generative AI (GenAI) are seen as the primary forces transforming professional work. The survey of over 2,200 professionals across various fields indicates a significant increase in the belief that AI will have a high or transformational impact on their work over the next five years, with 77% of respondents agreeing. Despite lingering concerns, fears around job loss are giving way to expectations of new AI-specialist roles, and professionals anticipate gaining up to four hours per week due to AI-powered tools.

title: EXCLUSIVE: Tech Valuations 'Pricey', Cybersecurity 'Top Of Mind' Ahead Of US Elections
summary: The tech sector, led by companies like Apple, Microsoft, and Nvidia, has driven market gains this year, but valuations are high. Direxion Managing Director Ed Egilinsky suggests that while growth needs to continue to support these valuations, cybersecurity is becoming a "top of mind" sector, especially as the U.S. election approaches. Investors are showing mixed sentiments, with some leveraged tech ETFs seeing outflows while others gain interest, and Egilinsky points to equal-weight ETFs for diversification and highlights Google and Meta as relatively more reasonably valued among the Magnificent Seven.

title: Peloton accused of providing customer chat data to train AI
summary: Peloton is facing a class-action lawsuit in California, accused of using customer chat data to train AI without user permission. The lawsuit, filed by Consumer Advocates, alleges Peloton violated the California Invasion of Privacy Act (CIPA) by sharing chat content with AI-powered marketing firm Drift. The core issue is whether Peloton properly informed users about the data sharing and obtained consent, with the court allowing the case to proceed despite Peloton's attempts to dismiss it.

title: IPO Market Outlook 2024: AI Fuels Tech Revival
summary: After a two-year downturn, the technology IPO market is experiencing a revival in 2024, largely driven by companies leveraging Artificial Intelligence. Morgan Stanley anticipates 10 to 15 tech IPOs this year, with AI's transformative potential attracting significant investor interest. Despite lingering economic uncertainties and higher interest rates compared to 2021, the market is adjusting, and successful IPOs in both tech and healthcare sectors demonstrate a renewed comfort with growth-focused investments.

title: Generative AI upskilling demands multiple methods, partners
summary: Global IT consultancies are adopting a multilayered approach to generative AI (GenAI) training, combining in-house programs, partnerships with technology vendors, and online learning platforms. This comprehensive strategy is essential to rapidly upskill over a million employees due to the exponential pace of change in GenAI, helping firms build credibility with customers and tech providers. Companies like NTT Data, TCS, Capgemini, Tech Mahindra, Cognizant, Atos, Leidos, and Hexaware are implementing tiered training, from basic fundamentals to advanced specializations, and integrating hands-on practice, gamification, and capstone projects to maximize engagement and practical application.

title: Alphabet calls off multibillion-dollar HubSpot acquisition
summary: Alphabet Inc. has reportedly abandoned its plans to acquire marketing software firm HubSpot Inc., causing HubSpot's stock to fall over 11%. The deal, which would have been Alphabet's largest acquisition, was likely called off due to anticipated regulatory scrutiny and a potential lack of clear benefit for HubSpot's customers. Analysts suggest the negotiations did not progress to detailed discussions and that regulatory bodies would have likely opposed the union.

title: Intuit Slashes 1,800 Jobs in AI Embrace
summary: Intuit announced the elimination of 1,800 jobs, representing 10% of its workforce, as it deepens its use of AI in services like TurboTax and QuickBooks. However, the company plans to hire an equal number of new employees, primarily in engineering, product, and customer-facing roles, to support its AI-augmented strategy. Intuit CEO Sasan Goodarzi stated that the job cuts were not for cost-cutting but for strategic reinvestment in critical AI-driven areas.

title: PLDT completes biggest data center
summary: PLDT Inc.'s data center arm, VITRO Inc., has completed its 11th and largest data center, VITRO Sta. Rosa, in Laguna. This $350-million facility covers five hectares and will double VITRO's capacity by adding 50 megawatts to its network. It is designed to cater to the growing demand for information storage from both public and private sectors and hyperscalers, with plans for further expansion to meet future cloud and AI technology requirements.

title: What Does Broadcom’s Stock Split Mean for Investors?
summary: Broadcom (AVGO) is implementing a 10-for-1 stock split after market close on July 12, distributing nine additional shares for each one owned. While the split will reduce the per-share price to make the stock more accessible to smaller investors, it does not change the company's fundamental valuation or Morningstar's fair value estimate, which will adjust from $1,550 to $155 per share post-split. This move follows other high-profile stock splits by companies like Nvidia, Walmart, Alphabet, Tesla, and Amazon, aiming to improve liquidity and make shares psychologically more attractive.

title: 3 Entertainment Stocks Dominating Streaming in 2024
summary: The article highlights three prominent entertainment stocks – Netflix (NFLX), TKO Group Holdings (TKO), and Alphabet (GOOG, GOOGL) – that are leading the streaming industry in 2024. It discusses how these companies are leveraging digital transformation, new ventures like live events and online betting, and strong market presence to drive growth and attract investors. The author emphasizes the growing global middle class and consistent demand for media as factors supporting the continued success of entertainment stocks.

title: AT&T's massive data breach deepens crisis for Snowflake seven weeks after hack was disclosed
summary: Snowflake is facing a deepening crisis following AT&T's announcement that a data breach, linked to a cloud platform owned by Snowflake, exposed customer call and text records from 2022. This incident, affecting "nearly all" AT&T wireless customers, comes seven weeks after Snowflake first disclosed a cyberattack impacting several clients. The breach was attributed to a financially motivated group, UNC5537, which exploited stolen login credentials, often from systems lacking multi-factor authentication, to export customer data and attempt extortion.

title: Apple at all-time high after Morgan Stanley calls stock 'top pick' for AI efforts
summary: Apple's shares reached a record high after Morgan Stanley named the stock a "top pick," citing the company's AI efforts as a significant boost to device sales. The investment bank raised its price target for Apple to $273 from $216, anticipating nearly 500 million iPhone sales over the next two years due to demand for its new Apple Intelligence features. This move positions Apple to capitalize on the growing interest in GenAI-enabled smartphones, even as its market share slightly declined.

title: Production Begins for New Plug & Play Recessed Light
summary: SKYX Platforms Corp. has announced the start of production for its new patented smart Plug & Play recessed light, aiming to revolutionize the smart home market and the multi-billion-unit global recessed light industry. This innovation, protected by patents in multiple key countries, offers a safer and more efficient installation process, controllable via various smart home systems. With bullish analyst ratings and strategic partnerships, SKYX is positioned to capitalize on the rapidly expanding smart home technology and recessed lighting markets.

title: Google defeats digital maps antitrust case in US court
summary: Google has won an antitrust case in California federal court, dismissing a proposed class-action lawsuit from marketing company Dream Big Media. The lawsuit claimed Google illegally restricted how customers use its digital mapping products, forcing them to pay higher prices by preventing the mixing of Google and non-Google data. U.S. District Judge Richard Seeborg dismissed the case with prejudice, stating the plaintiffs failed to provide sufficient evidence of Google monopolizing mapping services.

title: 看準AI突破投資盲點YouTube創辦人操盤ETF紐交所上市 | 鏡週刊
summary: YouTube創辦人陳士駿與華爾街金融背景的傅冠龍聯手創立「度雷克進化科技」，推出首檔AI驅動型ETF「DRAI」，已在美國紐約證券交易所上市。這檔ETF主打運用AI模型分析總體經濟數據與風險資產組合，以突破傳統投資盲點。傅冠龍表示，DRAI ETF的首年目標規模為3億美元，目前已吸引多國投資人關注。

title: Grayscale Launches New Fund Targeting Decentralized AI Protocols
summary: Grayscale has launched the Grayscale Decentralized AI Fund LLC to provide investors with exposure to decentralized AI protocols within the crypto ecosystem. The fund will quarterly rebalance a basket of protocols including Bittensor (TAO), Filecoin (FIL), Livepeer (LPT), Near (NEAR), and Render (RNDR). This initiative aims to address centralization risks in AI by supporting decentralized applications, combating misinformation, and building AI-related infrastructure.

title: Stocks to Buy: 7 Founder-Led Companies Set to Outperform
summary: This article highlights seven founder-led companies that are expected to outperform the market, drawing on research that suggests such firms are more innovative and adaptable. It features Tesla (TSLA), Nvidia (NVDA), Figs (FIGS), Regeneron Pharmaceuticals (REGN), Crowdstrike Holdings (CRWD), On Holding (ONON), and Hyatt Hotels (H). Each company's unique strengths, market position, and growth potential under founder leadership are discussed, providing insights into why they are considered strong investment opportunities.

title: Why CISOs should report to the CEO—and not the CIO
summary: This article argues that Chief Information Security Officers (CISOs) should report directly to the CEO rather than the CIO to effectively strategize with a cyber-first mindset. Cybersecurity experts emphasize that elevated reporting empowers CISOs to integrate security into business ventures from the outset, avoiding reactive problem-solving. Reporting to the CIO can create tension due to differing mandates, and considering modern business outsourcing, some believe the CIO role is diminishing in importance.

title: This Cybersecurity Stock Gains Analysts' Favor for Strong Growth
summary: Datadog (NASDAQ: DDOG) is gaining favor among Wall Street analysts due to its strong financial performance, leading position in the cybersecurity space, and optimistic growth projections. The company's significant revenue and subscription growth, coupled with strong free cash flow and high gross margins, are driving bullish price targets from firms like Loop Capital, Evercore, and Mizuho. Analysts see Datadog as a leader compared to peers like Zscaler and Fortinet, with substantial EPS growth expectations.

title: OpenAI reportedly holding talks with Broadcom and others to develop new AI server chip
summary: OpenAI is reportedly in discussions with chip designers, including Broadcom Inc., to develop a new AI server chip, an initiative led by CEO Sam Altman. This move aims to increase OpenAI's computing power for AI development and reduce its reliance on Nvidia Corp.'s GPUs, which are currently in short supply. The company is also hiring past Google LLC employees who worked on the tensor processing unit (TPU), with past ventures suggesting a substantial push to counter Nvidia's market dominance.

title: OpenAI, Nvidia, Google and others launch AI cybersecurity consortium
summary: A new industry group, the Coalition for Secure AI (CoSAI), has been launched by major tech firms including OpenAI, Nvidia, and Google, under the umbrella of OASIS. Its mission is to enhance the security of AI applications through the development of tools, technical guidance, and the sharing of cybersecurity best practices. CoSAI will initially focus on three open-source workstreams: scanning for AI cybersecurity risks, mitigating those risks, and addressing software supply chain vulnerabilities related to AI.

title: 3 Quantum Sensing Stocks Detecting Hidden Opportunities
summary: This article highlights three quantum sensing stocks — IonQ (IONQ), International Business Machines (IBM), and Honeywell International (HON) — as promising long-term investments. It discusses their current market positions, recent financial performance, and strategic initiatives in the rapidly growing quantum sensors market. The article emphasizes how these companies are leveraging quantum technology to create breakthroughs across various industries, from medicine and defense to cybersecurity and AI.

title: Skild AI估值100亿，今年最快独角兽诞生了
summary: Skild AI，一家由两位前卡内基梅隆大学教授于2023年5月创立的具身智能初创公司，在成立仅一年后完成了3亿美元的A轮融资，估值达到15亿美元（约109亿人民币），成为今年增长最快的独角兽之一。该公司致力于开发通用人工智能（AGI）驱动的人形机器人产品，专注于构建可应用于各种机器人的通用大脑Skild Brain。尽管融资火热，具身智能领域也面临商业化前景不明、大厂竞争激烈以及行业泡沫等挑战，如李开复等投资人对其短期落地和人形机器人必要性持保留态度。

title: 3 Edge Computing Stocks That Could Be Multibaggers in the Making: July Edition
summary: This article highlights three edge computing stocks—Arista Networks (ANET), Alphabet (GOOG, GOOGL), and Hewlett Packard Enterprise (HPE)—that are poised to benefit significantly from the generative AI boom. Edge computing, which involves processing data closer to its source, is experiencing rapid growth, creating substantial opportunities for companies providing supporting infrastructure and services. The author suggests these companies could become "multibaggers" as the demand for AI and edge computing solutions continues to expand.

title: How Salesforce Data Cloud supports CX for Principal Financial
summary: This article discusses how Principal Financial Group is utilizing Salesforce Data Cloud to enhance customer experience for its B2C and B2B2B businesses. summary: AST SpaceMobile has successfully launched its first five commercial satellites, known as BlueBirds, in collaboration with AT&T. summary: Uber and Waymo are expanding their driverless ride-hailing partnership to Austin and Atlanta, with Uber serving as the exclusive app for Waymo's autonomous vehicle services in these new markets. Experts suggest this move could increase institutional investor interest and stabilize the stock, but a secondary offering might cause a temporary price decrease. The company's stock has seen significant fluctuations, and increasing the float could help it gain broader market appeal beyond day traders.

title: Transact Campus Expands Across Canada with University of Victoria’s Mobile Credential Launch
summary: Transact Campus has launched its Mobile Credential solution at the University of Victoria, making it the sixth major Canadian post-secondary institution to adopt this technology. This initiative aims to enhance campus experiences by providing seamless access to services via Apple and Google Wallet for students, faculty, and staff, aligning with the university's commitment to sustainability and modern student services. Transact is planning further expansion across Canada in 2025.

title: Li Lu – Top 10 Holdings – Latest 13F
summary: This article details the top 10 holdings of superinvestor Li Lu's portfolio as of June 30, 2024, based on his latest 13F-HR filing. His portfolio has a market value of over $2.5 billion, with significant concentrations in companies like Bank of America, Alphabet, Berkshire Hathaway, and Apple. The article emphasizes using 13F-HR documents to track superinvestors' strategies.

title: Iron Mountain Transforms the Information Experience With New Digital Experience Platform
summary: Iron Mountain announced the launch of its InSight Digital Experience Platform (DXP), a secure SaaS platform designed to manage and monetize physical and digital information. This AI-powered platform helps customers automate workflows, ensure compliance, and turn unstructured data into actionable insights for AI initiatives. The DXP includes generative AI-powered chat and low-code tools, enabling businesses to enhance employee experiences and accelerate data-driven decisions.

title: GM’s Cruise has removed humans from the driver’s seat in some Houston tests—and put them in the passenger seat
summary: GM's autonomous car company, Cruise, has begun limited driverless testing in Houston, moving human safety drivers from behind the wheel to the passenger seat. This move is a crucial step towards restarting commercial robotaxi operations after a previous incident led to a hiatus. While Cruise works towards resuming service, it continues to incur significant losses, reporting a $435 million loss for the three months ended in September.

title: Amazon’s swelling cash pile makes conditions ripe for dividend
summary: Amazon's growing cash reserves, projected to exceed $100 billion this year, are leading many to believe that the e-commerce giant is poised to join other megacap companies in returning capital to shareholders, potentially through its first-ever dividend. Despite resistance from its CFO, investors anticipate a shift in strategy, especially given its relatively low buyback program compared to peers and the increasing trend of tech giants initiating or raising dividends. However, some analysts caution that Amazon's lower margins, due to its retail business, might make a dividend premature if it wants to maintain responsible stewardship.

title: Microsoft on the Edge: Bounce Back or Breakdown? Gear Up for Earnings Showdown
summary: This article from The Xchange Newsletter discusses upcoming Q3 earnings for various technology companies, including Microsoft. It highlights the potential for volatility around these earnings reports and suggests that traders should prepare for significant market movements. The piece also references several other articles related to earnings and market trends for major companies like Apple, Micron, Alphabet, and Nvidia.

title: Elastic Announces AI Ecosystem to Accelerate GenAI Application Development
summary: Elastic (NYSE: ESTC) has launched its AI Ecosystem to expedite the development and deployment of Retrieval Augmented Generation (RAG) applications for enterprises. This ecosystem integrates the Elasticsearch vector database with a curated selection of industry-leading AI technologies and tools. It aims to streamline the development process and improve the accuracy of GenAI applications by offering developers pre-built integrations for various critical components.

title: Amazon’s AI spending plans keep stock from joining tech rebound
summary: Amazon's shares are lagging behind its megacap peers due to its substantial spending on artificial intelligence computing, which is impacting its profits. Investors are concerned that increased capital spending will negatively affect cash flows, especially as the company has historically performed better when focused on profitability. This shift to investment mode, coupled with Amazon's lack of a dividend and less aggressive share buyback program compared to competitors, is causing investors to pause on the stock.

title: NRG, Renew Home and Google Cloud Announce Partnership
summary: NRG, Renew Home, and Google Cloud are partnering to create a nearly 1 GW AI-powered Virtual Power Plant (VPP) in Texas by 2035. This initiative aims to enhance grid resilience, reduce household energy costs through smart thermostats, and leverage Google Cloud's technology for improved energy management and forecasting. The VPP program will roll out to Texas customers in the spring of 2025.

title: Is The Trade Desk signaling the rebound of digital advertising?
summary: The Trade Desk (TTD) reported strong Q4 2023 earnings, exceeding lowered revenue guidance and raising Q1 2024 guidance, signaling a potential rebound in digital advertising. The company's AI-powered platform, Kokai, and its position in Connected TV (CTV) and shopper marketing are expected to drive future growth. Analysts have upgraded price targets, citing improved advertiser sentiment and a neutral to positive impact from Google's cookie deprecation.

title: Intuit’s CEO continues to ‘bet the company on AI and data’
summary: Intuit is laying off 1,800 employees, or 10% of its global workforce, as part of a strategic shift to increase investments in AI and generative AI, including its Intuit Assist. CEO Sasan Goodarzi stated the layoffs are not for cost-cutting but to reallocate resources and hire approximately 1,800 new employees with strategic functional skill sets, primarily in engineering, product, and customer-facing roles. The company's strategy emphasizes AI-native experiences, money movement, mid-market expansion, and international growth,

title: Eli Lilly's new CFO is a 23-year company veteran—showing how pharma firms rely on a 'deep bench of qualified talent'
summary: Eli Lilly has promoted 23-year company veteran Lucas Montarce to CFO, continuing a trend of internal promotions for executive roles within pharmaceutical companies. Montarce succeeds Anat Ashkenazi, who also spent two decades at Lilly before becoming CFO and recently moved to Google and Alphabet. Lilly's reliance on internal talent highlights its strong internal development programs, especially as the company experiences significant growth and invests heavily in expanding manufacturing for its top-selling drugs like Mounjaro and Zepbound.

title: Samsung Display's investment the biggest FDI project licensed in Vietnam in 2024
summary: Samsung Display Vietnam's (SDV) $1.8 billion project in Bac Ninh province was the largest foreign-invested project licensed in Vietnam in 2024, focusing on manufacturing OLED products for IT equipment and vehicles. This article details significant FDI projects in Vietnam for 2024, including major investments from Amkor, LG Display, Chinese automaker Chery, and South Korea’s Hyosung, highlighting the country's growing appeal for global technology and manufacturing giants. It also mentions future pledges from companies like Nvidia, SpaceX, and Siam Cement Group.

title: Synaptics partners with Google for multi-modal edge AI for IoT
summary: Synaptics and Google are collaborating to integrate Google's machine learning technology with Synaptics' Astra AI hardware and software. This partnership aims to develop multi-modal, context-aware devices capable of performing edge AI for IoT applications, supporting various modalities like vision, voice, and sound. The initiative seeks to bring transformative edge AI experiences across consumer, automotive, enterprise, and industrial systems.

title: Indexperts Quality Earnings Focused ETF Holdings
summary: This article details the holdings of the Indexperts Quality Earnings Focused ETF (QIDX), which was created on January 2, 2025, and focuses on total market equity. The actively managed ETF has $37.59 million in assets under management and holds 134 stocks, with its top holdings including Arista Networks Inc., Alphabet Inc., and Cisco Systems Inc. The fund aims to achieve total returns by investing broadly in US stocks across various market capitalizations.

title: Georgia Power warns customers to be ‘vigilant of scams’ in the new year
summary: Georgia Power is warning its customers to be vigilant against various scams, especially around the new year and tax season when scam attempts typically increase. The company highlighted tech scams involving unauthorized payment apps like Cash App and fake digital ads leading to fraudulent websites designed to steal personal or financial information. Georgia Power emphasized that it will never demand immediate payment via credit card, pre-paid debit card, cryptocurrency, or money transfer apps over the phone, nor collect payments in person outside of authorized locations.

title: Synaptics Gains on Google Collaboration to Advance Edge AI in IoT Applications
summary: Synaptics' shares jumped 8% following the announcement of a partnership with Google to enhance Edge AI for Internet of Things (IoT) applications. This collaboration combines Google's machine learning core with Synaptics' Astra AI-Native processing platform to enable context-aware computing and maximize multimodal processing in various consumer, business, and industrial devices. The initiative aims to accelerate AI research for IoT devices to seamlessly handle diverse input challenges like vision, speech, and sound, leveraging Synaptics' low-power silicon and Google's MLIR-compliant ML core.

title: QTUM: Investing In Quantum The Right Way (NASDAQ:QTUM)
summary: The article suggests that while quantum computing stocks are highly volatile, the Defiance Quantum ETF (QTUM) offers a safer and more diversified investment approach. It highlights Alphabet's advancements in quantum computing and McKinsey's projection of a significant market by 2040. Despite some bearish technical signals, QTUM is recommended for long-term portfolios due to its outperformance, reasonable expense ratio, and yield, although better entry points might appear soon.

title: Omnicom Media Group to partner with Google on search, Digiday reports
summary: Omnicom Media Group (OMG) is partnering with Google on a two-pronged search initiative. This collaboration, announced during CES, focuses on developing a planning tool and using AI for investment and creative decisions in search-driven efforts. This is the first of four major platform partnerships OMG plans to unveil this year.

title: How Akamai regained control of its runaway cloud bills
summary: Akamai, a technology company, significantly reduced its cloud spending by 40% in the first year of "Project Cirrus" after realizing its cloud bills had ballooned to hundreds of millions due to organic growth and acquisitions. The project involved repatriating some workloads to Akamai's acquired Linode cloud platform, reconfiguring others, and addressing inefficiencies like overprovisioning and a lack of oversight. Akamai's CIO, Kate Prouty, emphasized the importance of a strategic overhaul, educating engineers on cost stewardship, and making more deliberate choices for cloud workloads based on business outcomes.

title: Omnicom Media Group hits CES with a blitz of search-related partnerships, starting with Google
summary: Omnicom Media Group (OMG) announced a series of search-related partnerships at CES 2025, spearheaded by a significant collaboration with Google. This two-pronged partnership introduces a "Share of Voice" planning tool utilizing Google's Gemini AI for campaign optimization, and a "Next Generation Search Agent" to provide AI-driven investment and creative guidance within Omnicom's Omni platform. The initiatives aim to help clients navigate the evolving landscape of search marketing, particularly with the advancements of generative AI.

title: Nvidia's keynote at CES a positive catalyst for Super Micro Computer - Analyst
summary: Lynx Equity has reiterated a $60 price target for Super Micro Computer (SMCI), viewing Nvidia's CES keynote as a positive catalyst. The firm believes Super Micro's lead in liquid-cooled technology positions it well for the demands of Nvidia's next-gen GB300 platform and other AI server needs. Although considered speculative, the company's potential for a debt-financed capital raise could benefit inventory and AI server expansion.

title: Fubo’s stock skyrockets as Disney Hulu + Live TV deal creates YouTube TV rival
summary: Fubo's stock price surged over 250% after the company announced a deal to combine its service with Walt Disney Co.’s Hulu + Live TV. This merger aims to create a stronger virtual multichannel video programming distributor with a combined 6.2 million North American subscribers, positioning it as the second-largest online pay-TV provider, second only to Google’s YouTube TV.

title: QTUM ETF: The Diversified Way to Ride Quantum Computing Trends
summary: The Defiance Quantum ETF (NASDAQ: QTUM) offers investors diversified exposure to the emerging field of quantum computing, a technology poised to revolutionize industries like finance. This ETF provides a way to invest in quantum computing without picking individual stock winners, which can be risky. Top holdings include Rigetti Computing Inc. (NASDAQ: RGTI) and D-Wave Quantum Inc. (NYSE: QBTS), both showing significant momentum and institutional interest.

title: Can Kwai and Bigo Live replace TikTok? alternatives for 2025
summary: With a potential TikTok ban looming in early 2025, marketers and users are seeking alternative short-form video platforms. This article explores Kwai and Bigo Live as strong contenders, alongside established alternatives like YouTube Shorts and Instagram Reels. It details their strategies, target demographics, and features, assessing their potential to fill the void left by TikTok.

title: Delta Just Announced Its Plan to Use AI to Solve the Worst Thing About Traveling
summary: Delta Air Lines, celebrating its 100th birthday, announced several initiatives at CES, including Delta Concierge, an AI-powered personal assistant within its Fly Delta app. This new tool aims to personalize the travel experience, offering suggestions and eventually enabling complex commands like finding alternative flights using natural language, which could mitigate travel uncertainty. Other announcements included partnerships with Uber and YouTube, and a plan for free Wi-Fi across its global fleet.

title: What is the Google Gemini AI model (formerly Bard)?
summary: Google Gemini, previously known as Bard, is an AI chatbot developed by Google that uses NLP and machine learning to mimic human conversations. It is a multimodal AI large language model (LLM) capable of understanding language, audio, code, and video, and is integrated into various Google services and available for developers. The article details its functionality, evolution from Bard, various model sizes (Ultra, Pro, Nano), and its competitive landscape against other AI models like OpenAI's GPT-3 and GPT-4, while also addressing its limitations and concerns regarding bias and accuracy.

title: Lumen’s Finke Charts Network, AI Intersections
summary: Josh Finke, Lumen's Senior Vice President, Public Sector, discusses how Lumen Technologies is supporting Federal government agencies with network modernization and AI integration. The company is focusing on simplifying technology consumption, enhancing network security and reliability, and building an "AI fabric" to support data-intensive AI workloads. Finke also shared Lumen's perspective on Federal AI policy, emphasizing a multi-phase approach to AI adoption for measurable outcomes.

title: Apple, Google And Meta Can't Escape Gambling Lawsuits, Judge Rejects Section 230 Shield In Landmark Ruling On Casino-Style Apps
summary: A federal judge has ruled that Apple, Google, and Meta must face lawsuits alleging they profited from illegal casino-style apps, rejecting their Section 230 defense. The companies are accused of hosting and promoting addictive gambling apps and taking 30% commissions on in-app purchases, with plaintiffs seeking compensatory damages for alleged addiction and its consequences. This ruling adds to the growing legal scrutiny faced by tech giants.

title: ESPN, Fox, Warner Bros. Discovery Drop Venu Sports Joint Venture
summary: ESPN, Fox, and Warner Bros. Discovery have decided to shut down their joint venture, Venu Sports, before its public launch. This decision comes shortly after Disney, ESPN's parent company, settled an antitrust lawsuit with Fubo Inc. by acquiring a majority stake in Fubo and forming a new joint venture with them. The companies stated that they opted to focus on existing products and distribution channels, citing an "ever-changing marketplace."

title: Bentley Systems Welcomes James Lee as Chief Operating Officer
summary: Bentley Systems has appointed James Lee, formerly of Google and SAP, as its new Chief Operating Officer to drive operational excellence and growth initiatives. The company also streamlined its organizational structure by consolidating product development under Chief Technology Officer Julien Moutte, making the Chief Product Officer role redundant and leading to Mike Campbell's departure. These changes aim to accelerate innovation and capitalize on growth opportunities related to infrastructure AI.

title: What’s new with Matter: how Matter 1.4 is reshaping interoperability and energy management
summary: Matter 1.4 is the latest update to the smart home interoperability standard, introducing support for new device types like solar panels, heat pumps, and water heaters, alongside enhanced energy management features. This update also streamlines the multi-admin experience, allowing users to connect devices to several smart home systems more efficiently. While adoption is gradual, Matter 1.4 further solidifies the protocol's goal of creating a unified and user-friendly smart home ecosystem.

title: Liberty All-Star Equity Fund Reports December Decline Despite Strong 20.67% YTD Gains
summary: The Liberty All-Star Equity Fund (NYSE: USA) released its December 2024 monthly update, reporting a decline of -5.31% in NAV and -4.79% in market price for the month. Despite this, the fund maintained strong year-to-date returns of 14.06% (NAV) and 20.67% (market price). The fund, which categorizes as large-cap core, had net assets totaling $2,007.0 million, with 97.8% invested in equities, primarily in Information Technology, Financials, and Health Care.

title: EPAM Expands Collaboration with Google Cloud to Deliver Scalable AI Solutions for Industry Transformation
summary: EPAM Systems, Inc. announced an expanded strategic partnership with Google Cloud to deliver scalable AI solutions for industry transformation. The collaboration leverages Google Cloud’s Vertex AI platform to provide innovative solutions across media and entertainment, energy, and retail verticals, aiming to drive measurable business outcomes through generative AI, legacy modernization, and data analytics. This partnership will introduce four new solutions, including Video Search and Indexing, JenAii™ for Retail, Geospatial Data Visualization for Energy, and Talk to Your Data, enhancing customer satisfaction and operational efficiency.

title: At NRF, companies like Dick’s Sporting Goods and Sweetgreen talk up expanded uses of AI
summary: At the 2025 NRF Big Show, retailers demonstrated tangible applications of AI beyond basic customer service, focusing on operational efficiency. Dick's Sporting Goods showcased an AI-powered pricing model for inventory optimization, while Sweetgreen highlighted its "Infinite Kitchen" robotics for faster food preparation. Despite the benefits, experts like Centric Software's Joe Groves noted the overwhelming number of AI solutions on the market and the continued need for human oversight and contextual data in AI models, as emphasized by Dick's Sporting Goods.

title: AI revolution: Impact Series
summary: The article discusses the significant infrastructure demands of the AI revolution, highlighting the strain on resources like power, land, water, and materials due to increasing AI adoption and model training. It emphasizes the need for responsible and sustainable development of AI, examining energy consumption by data centers and the growing demand for "firm" and "dispatchable" power sources like nuclear and geothermal energy. Authors Christian Keller, William Thompson, and Akash Utsav contributed to this Impact Series report from Barclays Research, stressing the global challenge of balancing economic opportunities with environmental sustainability in AI development.

title: Comscore Announces Unified Content Measurement
summary: Comscore has launched Comscore Content Measurement (CCM), a new solution within The Comscore Platform that unifies content measurement across various channels and platforms. This advanced self-service tool provides content owners and creators with a holistic view of consumer behavior, enabling them to understand viewing habits and commercialize their offerings more effectively. CCM integrates measurement across linear TV, CTV/Streaming, PC, Mobile, and Social, offering deduplicated audience reach insights and enhancing content and ad monetization strategies for brands like Google, NBCUniversal, and Paramount.

title: Biden Administration Releases Executive Order on AI Infrastructure
summary: The Biden Administration issued an Executive Order on AI Infrastructure on January 14, 2025, aimed at advancing U.S. leadership in AI, preventing reliance on foreign infrastructure, and promoting clean energy for AI operations. The EO directs federal agencies to lease federal land for private-sector construction of "frontier AI infrastructure," including data centers and clean energy facilities, by specified timelines. It also outlines requirements for expedited permitting and upgrades to electricity grid infrastructure to support these AI developments.

title: CHAT: Generative AI Stocks Still Look Relatively Attractive
summary: The Roundhill Generative AI & Technology ETF (CHAT) has seen a significant rise of +13.60% since October 2024, outperforming the S&P 500. The ETF maintains a diversified portfolio with key holdings in NVIDIA, Alphabet, Microsoft, and Meta Platforms. While previously rated a "Strong Buy," the rating has been revised to "Buy" due to macroeconomic uncertainties, even as it appears between fair value and "slightly undervalued."

title: Oracle Named a Leader in the 2024 Gartner® Magic Quadrant™ for Cloud Database Management Systems
summary: Oracle has been recognized as a Leader in the 2024 Gartner® Magic Quadrant™ for Cloud Database Management Systems, highlighting its converged database architecture and continuous innovation. The company's database services, including Oracle Autonomous Database and Oracle Database 23ai, offer flexible intercloud and multicloud deployment choices, enabling customers to leverage various data and application development models for enterprise data and AI workloads. Oracle Database is lauded for its rapid pace of innovation and industry-leading multicloud capabilities, now available across AWS, Google Cloud, and Microsoft Azure.

title: Sonos takeover speculation grows, with Spotify or Amazon tipped as potential suitors (report)
summary: Speculation is mounting that audio technology company Sonos could be acquired following a problematic app rollout in 2024 and recent leadership changes, including the departure of CEO Patrick Spence. Bloomberg's Mark Gurman identifies Spotify and Amazon as the most likely suitors. While Amazon could integrate Sonos' premium audio into its Echo devices, Spotify could gain immediate entry into the hardware market, despite its past struggles with products like the "Car Thing."

title: Mike Philbrick's Past Picks:Global X., Cambria Foreign Shareholder Yield ETF and Harvest Healthcare Leaders Income ETF – BNN Bloomberg
summary: Mike Philbrick, CEO of ReSolve Asset Management, discusses his past ETF picks: Global X., Cambria Foreign Shareholder Yield ETF, and Harvest Healthcare Leaders Income ETF. The article provides details on these specific investment vehicles.

title: Google Cloud Solution Provider SADA Confirms Layoffs
summary: SADA, a Google Cloud solution provider, confirmed layoffs across various North American departments as part of resource alignment with strategic priorities. The company declined to disclose the percentage of employees affected but stated it has between 500 and 1,000 employees. SADA also mentioned providing support to employees impacted by Southern California wildfires, in addition to those affected by the layoffs.

title: Unveiling the Future of Agency Media Platforms: Omnicom’s Omni vs. the Competition - White Paper
summary: This white paper by The Myers Report examines the evolving landscape of agency media platforms, focusing on Omnicom Media Group's Omni. It analyzes Omni's advanced AI capabilities, cross-channel measurement tools, and personalization features, comparing them against rival platforms such as Publicis’ Epsilon PeopleCloud, WPP’s mPlatform, Dentsu’s Merkle M1, and IPG’s Acxiom and MAGNA. The report provides a detailed analysis of each platform's strengths, weaknesses, and future outlooks in the battle for dominance in data-driven media planning and buying.

title: 7 Best Content Distribution Platforms to Grow Your Reach
summary: This article identifies and compares seven top content distribution platforms for 2026, including Buffer, Bynder, Distribution.ai, Hootsuite, Mailchimp, RELAYTO, and StoryChief. It emphasizes the critical role of content distribution in ensuring content is seen by a wide audience, especially with evolving search engine algorithms and AI. The article also provides guidance on how to choose a suitable platform, highlighting factors like UI, usability, integrations, and cost, alongside advice for building an effective content distribution strategy.

title: Meta at ATH after Announcing Massive $65B CapEx Plan for AI Push 📈
summary: Meta Platforms has announced a massive $60-65 billion capital expenditure plan for 2025, a significant increase aimed at bolstering its AI infrastructure and becoming a leader in the AI landscape. This aggressive investment includes building a new data center and acquiring 1.3 million GPUs, with the goal of developing Meta AI into a leading assistant serving over a billion users. Despite the substantial spending, market reaction has been largely positive, pushing Meta's stock to an all-time high as investors support the company's strategic AI focus.

title: Tech’s TikTok Dilemma: Follow the Law or President Trump? (Published 2025)
summary: A federal law banning TikTok in the U.S. has created a schism among American tech companies, forcing them to choose between complying with the law or adhering to President-elect Trump's executive order to pause its enforcement. Companies like Amazon, Apple, and Google have moved to comply with the ban, while others like Oracle, Akamai, and Fastly continue to support TikTok. This situation highlights the legal and political complexities surrounding the TikTok ban and the varying approaches taken by major tech firms.

title: Webull Thailand Named Best Online Trading Platform for US Market Access by The Global Economics
summary: Webull Thailand has been recognized as the "Best Online Trading Platform for US Market Access" by The Global Economics, highlighting its rapid growth and commitment to innovative investment solutions. Since its launch, Webull Thailand has attracted over 300,000 registered users and was the most downloaded brokerage app in Thailand during November and December 2024. The platform offers unique features such as 24-hour trading of US stocks and ETFs and US options trading, aiming to connect Thai investors to global opportunities.

title: Exclusive: White House in talks to have Oracle and U.S. investors take over TikTok
summary: The White House is negotiating a deal where Oracle and U.S. investors would take majority control of TikTok's global operations, with Oracle overseeing the app's algorithm, data collection, and software updates. This plan aims to address concerns about the app's Chinese ownership by minimizing ByteDance's stake and ensuring American oversight. This negotiation follows a congressional mandate for TikTok to divest from its Chinese parent company or face a nationwide ban.

title: ETF of the Week: DGRW
summary: This article highlights the WisdomTree US Quality Dividend Growth Fund (DGRW) as the ETF of the Week, discussed by VettaFi’s Head of Research Todd Rosenbluth and Chuck Jaffe. DGRW focuses on high-quality companies with a forward-looking approach to dividend growth, suitable as a core or complementary holding in a portfolio. Despite a modest 2% yield, it offers capital appreciation potential and has received strong ratings from Lipper and Morningstar.

title: AI Stock Rout: Monday’s Selloff in 5 Charts
summary: A new AI model from Chinese startup DeepSeek, which performs advanced AI tasks without relying on the most advanced semiconductor chips, triggered a significant selloff in AI-related stocks on Monday. Nvidia plunged 17%, and other chipmakers and AI-beneficiary sectors like utilities also saw steep declines. However, some large-cap tech names like Apple and Meta Platforms posted gains, and Morningstar analysts maintain their fair value estimates for key tech companies, anticipating long-term benefits from reduced AI model pricing.

title: Aurora Mobile Partners With China's DeepSeek To Boost AI Capabilities
summary: Aurora Mobile's enterprise AI platform, GPTBots.ai, has integrated China's DeepSeek R1 large language model (LLM), enhancing its capabilities alongside existing models like OpenAI, Meta Llama, and Google Gemini. This integration aims to provide businesses with more efficient, adaptable, and cost-effective advanced AI solutions, leveraging DeepSeek R1's strong reasoning tasks performance and affordability. The partnership positions GPTBots.ai as a comprehensive platform for diverse LLMs, allowing businesses to select models catering to specific operational, customer service, or marketing needs.

title: Investors Shovel Over $100 Million Into This ETF Betting on the Rise of Nuclear Power
summary: The Range Nuclear Renaissance Index ETF (NUKZ) has attracted over $100 million in investments, demonstrating significant interest in nuclear power as a cleaner, safer, and more reliable energy source. Launched in January 2024, the ETF has shown impressive growth and returns, appealing to investors seeking energy security and sustainable solutions. Experts anticipate continued growth for the nuclear power industry and related investments due to recent innovations, international agreements, and increasing public demand.

title: Nvidia calls China’s DeepSeek R1 model ‘an excellent AI advancement’
summary: Nvidia praised China's DeepSeek R1 model as "an excellent AI advancement" despite concerns that it contributed to a 17% drop in Nvidia's stock. DeepSeek's open-source reasoning model reportedly outperformed leading U.S. models like OpenAI's, with significantly lower training costs. Nvidia views this breakthrough as a driver for more work for its GPUs, emphasizing "Test Time Scaling" as a new form of scaling law in AI development.

title: Healthcare platform Agilon valued at about $11 billion in NYSE debut
summary: Healthcare platform Agilon health achieved a valuation of nearly $11 billion on its NYSE debut, with shares opening 23% above their offer price. The company, controlled by an investment fund associated with Clayton Dubilier & Rice, raised over $1 billion in its IPO. Agilon connects primary care physicians with senior patients enrolled in Medicare Advantage plans.

title: Harvard Endowment Reinvests $150M in Company Tied to Israeli Settlements in Palestine
summary: The Harvard Management Company (HMC) has reinvested $150 million in Booking Holdings Inc., making it the third-largest holding in its public portfolio. This company is on a 2023 UN list for business activities in Israeli settlements in the West Bank, sparking renewed debate and divestment calls amid heightened pro-Palestine activism at Harvard. HMC's decision comes despite significant student protests and follows a previous divestment from the company in 2020.

title: AI stock rout: The US selloff in 4 charts
summary: US stocks experienced a selloff, particularly in large-cap growth, following news that Chinese AI startup DeepSeek developed an advanced AI model that requires less sophisticated semiconductor chips. This development triggered concerns about the necessity of significant capital expenditures by large US tech companies in generative AI, leading to a 17% plunge in Nvidia stock and declines in other chipmakers and utility stocks. However, some tech giants like Apple and Meta Platforms saw gains, and Morningstar analysts maintain their fair value estimates for Microsoft, Amazon, and Alphabet, expecting long-term benefits from reduced AI model pricing.

title: RBC’s plans to marry large language and transaction models
summary: RBC is integrating its in-house AI models, trained on vast financial data, with large language models developed by a local rival to Microsoft and Google. This initiative aims to address a paradox in banking where generative AI excels more in language tasks than complex numerical calculations, despite the technology's potential to revolutionize financial operations. The bank is exploring how these combined AI capabilities can be applied to both internal processes and customer-facing services.

title: FY25 Q2 - Press Releases - Investor Relations
summary: Microsoft announced strong second-quarter fiscal year 2025 results, driven by significant growth in Microsoft Cloud and AI. The company reported $69.6 billion in revenue, a 12% increase, and a 17% increase in operating income to $31.7 billion. Microsoft's AI business alone surpassed an annual revenue run rate of $13 billion, marking a 175% year-over-year increase.

title: Don’t Forget to Rebalance Sector Exposures
summary: This article emphasizes the importance of rebalancing investment portfolios to maintain desired asset allocation and manage risk, especially after strong performance in certain sectors. It highlights three sectors—communication services, information technology, and financials—that saw significant returns in 2024 and may require rebalancing. The article provides specific ETF examples and their 2024 NAV returns to illustrate sector performance.

title: Meta Posts Q4 Earnings Beat, But Reality Labs Losses Mount
summary: Meta Platforms reported strong Q4 2024 earnings, exceeding analysts' expectations in revenue and EPS, driven by its Family of Apps (Facebook, Instagram, WhatsApp). However, the Reality Labs division continued to incur substantial operating losses, raising concerns about the metaverse's future and prompting significant AI infrastructure investments. Despite these losses, Meta's shares performed well, indicating investor confidence in Zuckerberg's overall strategy.

title: Wix partners with YouTube to support social shopping experience -
summary: Wix.com has announced a new integration with YouTube Shopping, allowing its merchants to sell products directly through YouTube. This partnership expands Wix's social shopping capabilities, enabling merchants to display products on their YouTube profiles, tag items in videos and live streams, and track performance using YouTube's analytics. The collaboration simplifies the selling process for businesses and enhances the shopping experience for consumers directly within YouTube.

title: Yext CEO awarded $500k bonus, director resigns
summary: Yext, Inc. has awarded CEO Michael Walrath a one-time cash bonus of $500,000 for his contributions to operational efficiency. Simultaneously, Julie Richardson is stepping down from her role as a board member after nearly a decade, with her departure not being due to disagreements. These changes occur as Yext approaches its fiscal year-end, prompting investor attention to the company's future strategic direction.

title: Alphabet director Frances Arnold sells $22,000 in class C stock
summary: Alphabet director Frances Arnold recently sold 110 shares of the company's Class C Capital Stock for $22,000. This transaction was conducted under a Rule 10b5-1 Trading Plan and leaves Arnold with 16,819 shares. The sale occurred while Alphabet's stock is near its 52-week high, amidst other positive developments for the company.

title: BlackRock launches two ETFs for European investors focused on US equities: QTOP and QNXT
summary: BlackRock has launched two new ETFs, the iShares Nasdaq 100 Top 30 UCITS ETF and the iShares Nasdaq 100 ex-Top 30 UCITS ETF, for European investors to gain more granular exposure to US equities, specifically the Nasdaq 100 index.
